purpose: disjoint development pilot correcting the instance-overlap defect documented for fixed-baseline pilot v1; not validation or test evidence

requirements: a first-run policy-eligible root decision exists in the leakage-safe observational view
the first-run observed applied count is strictly between zero and the logical-candidate count
the local MPS file exists and matches the recorded SHA-256
the instance does not occur in the first-run pilot or cohorts A, B, or C
selection_contract.sampling: sort all satisfying instances by source trace elapsed seconds and then instance id; take the first eight
selection_contract.outcome_blinding: no v2 native or treatment outcome existed or was inspected before this plan was committed
selection_contract.role: disjoint training-split development evidence only; validation and test remain sealed

experiment_contract.process_isolation: one fresh Python/SCIP process per instance, seed, and arm
experiment_contract.selected_cut_budget: each fixed baseline preserves native hybrid selected-cut count and leaves forced cuts untouched
experiment_contract.primary_metric: PAR-2 penalized solving-time ratio, aggregated over seeds and then instances
experiment_contract.analysis_command: scip-cut-trace-v2-paper-stats with 10000 instance-cluster bootstrap replicates and seed 20260717

checks_per_action: all eight native arms complete for all three seeds
actual selected-set changes occur on at least five instances
the upper endpoint of the 95% instance-cluster bootstrap interval for the PAR-2 time ratio is below 1.0
pilot_gate.selection_rule: an action advances only if it passes every check; if several pass, choose the smallest penalized-time ratio, resolving exact ties in the fixed order efficacy-rank, adaptive-score, random-rank
pilot_gate.passing_consequence: report disjoint training-split support and pre-register a separate official-Group-OOD validation experiment; this does not authorize test access
pilot_gate.failure_consequence: do not tune or enlarge a failed action on these outcomes
